scope: Local synthetic illustrations rendered through candidate Notion renderer, Chromium and Linux WebKit plus existing renderer security tests. No Notion writes; no production signed image availability or physical iPhone certification.

tests.title: image retains caption and position between text blocks
keyboard opens preview and Escape restores opener focus
preview zooms and closes without leaving material
unsafe image URL does not create an image or executable link
broken image shows explanation and safe source link
